_about: Planet generation 2's rivers (docs/world/rivers.md; read by sim/world/rivers.gd). enabled: off, nothing here runs and a planet is as it was. rain: runoff a land cell sheds is its carried moisture over `dry` (times gain), none where the temperature is under `frozenT` (a frozen river is not a channel). flow: a cell whose runoff, added up downstream, passes `river` is a river cell; `ref` is the flow a river of the base width carries. span: where a ring crosses a river it is a channel `width0 + width1 x sqrt(flow / ref)` columns wide (at least minCols, at most maxCols), `depth0 + depth1 x sqrt(flow / ref)` units deep at most maxDepth (under the depth that hides a fighter, so a river is always waded), its flat surface `freeboard` under the lower of the two banks (read `bank` columns outside the channel), snapped to the lowest ground within `reach` columns of the geometric crossing, never on ground under `floor` (the sea's edge) or within `margin` columns of a settlement or on a settlement's ground. spacing: of the crossings at most one is kept in any gapUnits (Game Design 23b row 13: the strongest; crossings under 640 units apart are one span), and at most maxPerRing a ring. refuse: fine biomes a river does not cross.
